season.sr: Otvoren cele godine, svakog dana od 10 sati; leti radi duže, a zimi se zatvara ranije.
season.en: Open all year, every day from 10:00; longer hours in summer, earlier closing in winter.

tagline.sr: Zoo bez ograda, gde lavovi i lemuri gledaju tebe pravo u oči.
tagline.en: A barrier-free zoo where lions and lemurs look you straight in the eye.

description.sr: Bioparc je savremeni zoološki vrt u srcu Valensije, uređen po modelu „imerzije“: nema klasičnih rešetki, nego jaruge, reke i stene razdvajaju životinje od posetilaca, pa se i najmanji osećaju kao da šetaju kroz afričku savanu. Staze su široke i ravne, idealne za kolica, a senke i mesta za odmor ima na svakom koraku. Mališane najviše oduševljavaju surikati, lemuri i veliki gorile, koje mogu da posmatraju sa sasvim male razdaljine.
description.en: Bioparc is a modern zoo in the heart of Valencia built on the 'immersion' model: instead of bars, ditches, rivers and rocks separate the animals from visitors, so even the youngest feel they are walking through an African savannah. Paths are wide and flat, ideal for a pushchair, with shade and rest spots everywhere. Toddlers are especially taken with the meerkats, lemurs and the great gorillas, which they can watch from very close range.

tagline.sr: Najstariji zoo na svetu, u carskom parku — pande, pingvini i lavlja mladunčad.
tagline.en: The world's oldest zoo, in an imperial park — pandas, penguins and lion cubs.

description.sr: Šenbrunski zoo, osnovan 1752, najstariji je zoološki vrt na svetu, a smešten je u prelepom parku oko dvorca Šenbrun. Poznat je po džinovskim pandama, pingvinima i severnim medvedima, a redovno ga biraju za najbolji zoo u Evropi. Za porodice je savršen jer se lako obilazi kolicima, ima mnogo igrališta i mesta za odmor, a kombinuje se sa dvorcem i Dečjim muzejom Šenbrun. Deca do 6 godina ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Schönbrunn Zoo, founded in 1752, is the oldest zoo in the world and sits in the lovely park around Schönbrunn Palace. It is famous for its giant pandas, penguins and polar bears, and is regularly voted one of Europe's best zoos. It is perfect for families because it is easy to get around with a pushchair, has plenty of playgrounds and rest spots, and combines with the palace and the Schönbrunn Children's Museum. Children under 6 go free.

tagline.sr: Centralni akvarijum velik kao okean — mante, ajkule i vidre u jednom prostoru.
tagline.en: A central tank the size of the ocean — rays, sharks and otters in one space.

description.sr: Okeanarijum u Lisabonu, u modernom okrugu Parka nacija, jedan je od najvećih zatvorenih akvarijuma u Evropi. Njegov centralni rezervoar je toliko velik da se posetioci šetaju na dva nivoa oko njega, a ogromne mante i ajkule plivaju tik pored stakla. Zatvoren je i klimatizovan, pa je savršen za kišni dan ili beg od vrućine, a mališani satima ne skidaju pogled sa vidri i pingvina. Deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno.
description.en: Lisbon Oceanarium, in the modern Parque das Nações district, is one of Europe's largest indoor aquariums. Its central tank is so big that visitors walk around it on two levels, and huge manta rays and sharks swim right past the glass. It is indoor and air-conditioned, so it is perfect for a rainy day or an escape from the heat, and little ones cannot take their eyes off the otters and penguins. Children under 3 go free.

tagline.sr: Papagaji, delfini i pingvini na tropskom ostrvu — ali imajte na umu predstave orki.
tagline.en: Parrots, dolphins and penguins on a tropical island — but mind the orca shows.

description.sr: Loro Park u Puerto de la Kruzu je svetski poznat zoo i botanička bašta na Tenerifima, sa hiljadama papagaja, velikim akvarijumom i najvećom zbirkom pingvina na svetu izvan Antarktika. Mališani su oduševljeni tunelom kroz akvarijum sa ajkulama i razigranim morskim lavovima. Zbog toga što drži orke i priređuje predstave sa njima, park je često meta kritika organizacija za zaštitu životinja — o tome vredi razmisliti pre posete.
description.en: Loro Parque in Puerto de la Cruz is a world-famous zoo and botanical garden in Tenerife, with thousands of parrots, a large aquarium and the world's biggest penguin collection outside Antarctica. Little ones love the shark tunnel and the playful sea lions. Because it keeps orcas and puts on shows with them, the park is regularly criticised by animal-welfare organisations — something worth thinking about before visiting.

tagline.sr: Besplatan park na vrhu brda s pogledom na Mont Blan i Ženevsko jezero.
tagline.en: A free hilltop park with views of Mont Blanc and Lake Geneva.

description.sr: Signal de Bugi je prostrani park za porodice na brdu između Ženeve i Lozane, sa prelepim pogledom na Ženevsko jezero i Mont Blan. Sam ulaz u park, igrališta, sportski tereni i vrt sa životinjskim skulpturama su besplatni, a plaća se samo pojedinačno — vozić, mini-golf, trampolina ili Kid'z Land zona za najmlađe. Idealno je za lagan dan u prirodi, sa piknikom i šetnjom po šumskim stazama.
description.en: Signal de Bougy is a spacious family park on a hill between Geneva and Lausanne, with beautiful views over Lake Geneva and Mont Blanc. Entry to the park, the playgrounds, sports fields and the garden with animal sculptures are free, and you only pay per activity — the little train, mini-golf, trampoline or the Kid'z Land area for the youngest. It is ideal for an easy day in nature, with a picnic and walks on forest paths.

tagline.sr: Najveći zabavni park Italije, na obali najlepšeg alpskog jezera.
tagline.en: Italy's biggest theme park, on the shore of its loveliest alpine lake.

description.sr: Gardaland je najveći i najpoznatiji zabavni park Italije, smešten na jugoistočnoj obali jezera Garda. Iako ga mnogi znaju po velikim toboganima, park ima i bogat dečji deo sa mirnim vožnjama, vrtuljcima i predstavama za najmlađe, plus SEA LIFE akvarijum i vodeni park. Za porodice sa decom od 3 do 6 godina ovo je odličan izbor — deca niža od 1 metra ulaze besplatno, iako je za njih ograničen broj vožnji.
description.en: Gardaland is Italy's biggest and best-known theme park, on the south-eastern shore of Lake Garda. Though many know it for its big roller coasters, the park also has a rich children's area with gentle rides, carousels and shows for the youngest, plus a SEA LIFE aquarium and a water park. For families with children aged 3 to 6 it is a great choice — children under 1 metre tall enter free, although they are limited to fewer rides.

tagline.sr: Jahanje kamila i plitko more — tropski duh na pola sata od aerodroma.
tagline.en: Camel rides and shallow sea — a tropical feel half an hour from the airport.

description.sr: Park kamila u mestu Mazotos, petnaestak minuta od Larnake, prava je porodična atrakcija — deca mogu da jašu kamile i ponije, hrane životinje i brčkaju se u bazenu uključenom u cenu ulaznice. U kombinaciji sa plitkim, peščanim plažama Larnake koje su idealne za malu decu, ovo je opuštena destinacija za prvi porodični odmor na moru. Objekti su jednostavni, ali mališanima je više nego dovoljno.
description.en: The Camel Park in the village of Mazotos, about fifteen minutes from Larnaca, is a real family attraction — children can ride camels and ponies, feed the animals and splash in the pool included in the entry price. Combined with Larnaca's shallow, sandy beaches, ideal for small children, this makes a relaxed destination for a first family beach holiday. The facilities are simple, but more than enough for little ones.

tagline.sr: Muzej napravljen samo za decu — sve se sme dirati, od vode do supermarketa.
tagline.en: A museum built just for children — everything can be touched, from water to a supermarket.

description.sr: Explora je dečji muzej u srcu Rima, pored Pijace del Popolo, namenjen deci do 12 godina. Sve je interaktivno: deca se igraju u mini-supermarketu, eksperimentišu sa vodom, snimaju u studiju i voze auto — uče kroz igru, a roditelji su dobrodošli svuda. Posebno je dragocen u vrućim ili kišnim danima kada treba pobegne sa ulice. Ulaz je po terminima, pa je bolje rezervisati unapred.
description.en: Explora is a children's museum in the heart of Rome, next to Piazza del Popolo, aimed at children up to 12. Everything is hands-on: children play in a mini-supermarket, experiment with water, record in a studio and drive a car — learning through play, with parents welcome everywhere. It is especially valuable on hot or rainy days when you need to get off the street. Entry is by timed slot, so it is better to book ahead.

tagline.en: A science museum where under-16s go free — a flooded forest indoors.

description.sr: KosmoKaša je naučni muzej na obroncima Tibidaba, poznat po svom „Poplašljivom vrhu“ — replike poplavljene amazonske šume u ogromnom staklenom prostoru. Za porodice je odličan izbor jer je ulaz za decu do 16 godina besplatan, a interaktivni eksponati, geološki zid i planetarijum drže pažnju i najmlađih. Zatvoren je i klimatizovan, pa je sigurna opcija za kišni dan u Barseloni.
description.en: CosmoCaixa is a science museum on the slopes of Tibidabo, famous for its 'Flooded Forest' — a replica of a flooded Amazon forest in a vast glass space. It is a great choice for families because entry is free for under-16s, and the interactive exhibits, the geological wall and the planetarium hold even the youngest ones' attention. It is indoor and air-conditioned, so it is a safe option for a rainy day in Barcelona.

tagline.sr: Šareno filmsko selo u uvali — kulise filma o Popaju postale porodični park.
tagline.en: A colourful film village in a cove — the Popeye movie set turned family park.

description.sr: Popajevo selo u uvali Ankor Bej na severu Malte izgrađeno je kao kulisa za film „Popaj“ iz 1980. i danas je veseli porodični park sa drvenim kućicama, predstavama i animacijama. Leti se u uvali kupa i vozi na vodenim gumenjacima, a zimi park radi u smanjenom obimu. Za malu decu su najzanimljiviji susreti sa Popajem i Olajkom, mini-golf i mirna uvala sa bistrim, plitkim morem.
description.en: Popeye Village in Anchor Bay in the north of Malta was built as the set for the 1980 film 'Popeye' and is now a cheerful family park with wooden houses, shows and entertainment. In summer you can swim in the cove and ride water inflatables, and in winter the park runs on a reduced schedule. For small children the highlights are meeting Popeye and Olive, mini-golf and the calm cove with clear, shallow water.

tip.en: Bring swimwear and water — the cove gets very hot in summer and in-park prices are higher.

tagline.sr: Stakleni tunel među ajkulama u srcu tržnog centra — savršeno za kišni dan.
tagline.en: A glass tunnel among sharks inside a shopping centre — perfect for a rainy day.

description.sr: Tropikarijum u budimpeštanskom tržnom centru Kampona jedan je od najvećih akvarijuma Centralne Evrope, sa morskom vodom i staklenim tunelom kroz koji ajkule i raže plivaju iznad vaših glava. Zatvoren je, topao i lako se obilazi, pa je idealan za hladne ili kišne dane, a deca do 3 godine ulaze besplatno. Osim akvarijuma, tu su terarijumi sa zmijama i krokodilima i prateća zona sa hranom i igraonicom.
description.en: The Tropicarium inside Budapest's Campona shopping centre is one of Central Europe's largest aquariums, with seawater and a glass tunnel where sharks and rays glide over your head. It is indoor, warm and easy to get around, so it is ideal for cold or rainy days, and children under 3 enter free. Besides the aquarium there are terrariums with snakes and crocodiles, plus a food court and play area nearby.

tagline.sr: Dinosaurusi koji se pomeraju i riču, u poljskom gradu Zabavnih parkova.
tagline.en: Dinosaurs that move and roar, in Poland's town of amusement parks.

description.sr: Zatorland je porodični zabavni park u gradiću Zator, pola sata od Krakova, poznat po Dinozatorlandu — šumi sa desetinama pokretnih, ričućih dinosaurusa u prirodnoj veličini. Osim dinosaurusa, tu su Park mitova sa čamcima, Park bajki, vodeni park i brojna igrališta. Najbolje odgovara deci od 3 do 8 godina, a za mališane niže od 90 cm ulaz je gotovo simboličan.
description.en: Zatorland is a family amusement park in the little town of Zator, half an hour from Kraków, known for Dinozatorland — a forest with dozens of life-size dinosaurs that move and roar. Besides dinosaurs there is a Mythology Park with boats, a Fairytale Park, a water park and many playgrounds. It suits children aged 3 to 8 best, and for little ones under 90 cm entry is almost symbolic.

tagline.en: A bio-park with a pool and sandy beach in one — safari and a swim on the same day.

description.sr: Zoom Torino u Kumjani, blizu Torina, moderan je biopark uređen po uzoru na afričke i azijske habitate, sa životinjama bez klasičnih kaveza. Posebno je privlačan leti jer ima peščanu plažu i bazene u sklopu ulaznice, pa dan može da se podeli između razgledanja i kupanja. Za malu decu su najbolji vozić kroz park, hranjenje životinja i blaga šetnja senovitim stazama.
description.en: Zoom Torino in Cumiana, near Turin, is a modern bio-park modelled on African and Asian habitats, with animals kept without classic cages. It is especially appealing in summer because it has a sandy beach and pools included in the ticket, so the day can be split between sightseeing and swimming. For small children the best parts are the little train through the park, the animal feedings and a gentle walk along shaded paths.

name.sr: Selo Deda Mraza (Le Hameau du Père Noël)

season.sr: Otvoren tokom cele godine po sezonskom rasporedu; najviše se posećuje zimi, od oktobra do januara.
season.en: Open all year on a seasonal schedule; busiest in winter, from October to January.

tagline.sr: Kuća Deda Mraza u kojoj Božić traje cele godine, na pola sata od Ženeve.
tagline.en: Santa's house where it is Christmas all year, half an hour from Geneva.

description.sr: Selo Deda Mraza (Le Hameau du Père Noël) nalazi se u Sen-Blezu u francuskoj Gornjoj Savoji, na prevoju Mon Sion između Ženeve i Anecija, u sklopu parka Grand Parc d'Andilly. Deca obilaze Dedin dom — njegovu kuhinju, spavaću sobu i radionicu igračaka — uz animirane lutke, zvonca i priče uz kamin, a u vrtu ih čekaju vilenjaci. Posebno je čarobno zimi, kad je ceo kompleks pretvoren u božićni park.
description.en: Le Hameau du Père Noël is in Saint-Blaise in France's Haute-Savoie, on the Mont Sion pass between Geneva and Annecy, within the Grand Parc d'Andilly complex. Children explore Santa's home — his kitchen, bedroom and toy workshop — with animated figures, bells and stories by the fire, while elves await in the garden. It is especially magical in winter, when the whole complex becomes a Christmas park.

description.sr: Guliverlandija u Linjanu Sabijadoru je porodični tematski park namenjen pre svega deci od 3 do 8 godina, sa mirnim vožnjama, vrtuljcima i predstavama inspirisanim Guliverovim putovanjima. U kompleksu su i akvarijum sa tunelom i kuća leptira, a blizina peščanih plaža Linjana znači da se park lako kombinuje sa morem. Za bebe i decu do 2 godine sadržaja je malo, pa je najbolji izbor od treće godine.
description.en: Gulliverlandia in Lignano Sabbiadoro is a family theme park aimed mainly at children aged 3 to 8, with gentle rides, carousels and shows inspired by Gulliver's Travels. The complex also includes an aquarium with a tunnel and a butterfly house, and being close to Lignano's sandy beaches means the park combines easily with the sea. There is little for babies and under-2s, so it is best from age 3.
